findings.title: Plaintext HTTP Serves Content Without Auto-HTTPS Upgrade
findings.description: The server is reachable over secure HTTPS, but plain unencrypted HTTP requests on port 80 continue to serve content without issuing an immediate HTTP 301 upgrade to HTTPS.
findings.evidence: Initial request to http://znsstudios.com reached final URL: http://znsstudios.com/
findings.remediation: Configure your webserver/reverse proxy (Nginx/Apache/Cloudflare) to issue an automatic HTTP 301 Permanent Redirect from port 80 to https://$host$request_uri.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.description: The application does not declare a Content-Security-Policy header. CSP restricts unauthorized executable scripts, style sources, and mitigates Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data exfiltration.
findings.remediation: Define a restrictive Content-Security-Policy header declaring allowed origins for scripts, styles, objects, and connect endpoints.
findings.codeSnippet: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self';" always;

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.description: HSTS ensures that user browsers strictly connect to the application over encrypted TLS, mitigating SSL stripping and downgrade attacks.
findings.remediation: Enable HSTS with a minimum max-age of 31536000 (1 year), includeSubDomains, and consider preload registration.

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
